caption:
Physicists just discovered mathematical limits to reversing time, but what if time ran backward on Earth for just sixty seconds? Instantly, spilled coffee would leap from the floor back into your mug. Shattered plates would assemble seamlessly, and rain would fly back into the clouds. In physics, entropy normally forces disorder to increase. Reversing macro-events would absorb heat from the air, momentarily freezing surroundings while repairing broken objects. Which moment from today would you undo? Follow for more what-ifs.

Based on today's news: Physicists Find a Mathematical Limit to Making Time Run Backward - ScienceAlert
